newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Monday as some contracts recovered from earlier price losses, but local investors could not find clear direction, traders said.

All contracts fell at the opening, reflecting the weaker CBOT market on Friday and the yen's initial gains against the dollar in the Tokyo morning, traders said. Light technical buying supported some contracts later, they said.
Prices ranged from 80 yen lower to 80 yen higher, with the benchmark March 1998 contract down 10 yen at 16,200 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 36,672 lots.
The spot May contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.98-1/4 per bushel at 0825 GMT, against $3.00-1/4 at Friday's close.
The spot May of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.38 per bushel at 0825 GMT, down from $8.42-1/2 at Friday's close.
